named_events.loss_description: Gross claims mainly in Japanese Yen; recoveries in US Dollars leading to a currency shortfall exposure
Gross claims mainly in Japanese Yen; contributed to currency shortfall
Gross claims mainly in Japanese Yen; contributed to currency shortfall
Largest RDS in July 2020 submission: industry loss estimate US$1.1 trillion equating to a loss to the Syndicate of US$215.8m gross and US$42.1m net of reinsurance and reinstatement costs

data.standardized_narrative: The opening gross claims reserve at 1 January 2020 was GBP 151.557m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 1.55m (a 1.02% release relative to opening reserves), driven by a larger release on older years (notably 2017) partly offset by adverse development on subsequent prior years (notably 2018). The report references large catastrophe claims (Typhoons Jebi, Faxai and Hagibis) and JPY currency effects on reinsurance recoveries which have influenced reserve dynamics. No single large gross prior-year movement is explicitly stated; the prior-year movement above is calculated from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and the margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than assumed is at its highest.

The Syndicate holds assets and liabilities in these six main currencies. The Syndicate for the most part aims to ensure its assets and liabilities match in currency as closely as possible to mitigate the currency risk. The currency shortfall in Japanese Yen is partly driven by the gross claims for Typhoons Hagibis, Faxai and Jebi being mainly in Japanese Yen but any recoveries being in US Dollars. However, it should be noted that there is a degree of currency mitigation because the reinsurance collections made on this loss are based on the gross loss in Japanese Yen being converted to sterling at the prevailing exchange rate to mitigate the currency risk.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 42-43) using the diagonal method (excluding the two most recent underwriting years). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior years' gross figure was provided. The computed PYD (-GBP 1.552m) is therefore derived and has been rounded to three decimal places. There is some potential distortion risk from RITC/Part VII items mentioned elsewhere (Part VII/transfer of EEA policies) but these relate to specific EEA policy transfers and are not quantified against the gross triangle movements used.
